thread:
alex: Kicking off SJC6 cluster bootstrap readiness check — posting live checklist and current blockers.

maria: TL;DR: hardware brought up, networking attached, need validation on GPU scheduling & NAT egress.

shawn: I ran the initial node health check, one node shows GPU driver mismatch on node-07.

lina: noted. can you paste the `dmesg` / driver output? I can push the hotfix package.

shawn: `nvidia-smi` shows `Driver Version: 535.54` on most nodes, node-07 is `520.61` — likely missed during image bake.

lina: pushing image v3.1.2 with updated driver now. will cordon+drain node-07, then redeploy. ETA 8m.

ops-bot: deploy started by lina. job_id=deploy-2623. watch: https://ci.redwood/devops/deploys/2623

alex: Great — while that runs, quick status on infra gates: 
- SLOs: p95 latency < 120ms for small-gen (<=512 tokens), p99 < 300ms
- GPU health: all GPUs pass mem/test at 90s burn-in
- Networking: cross-AZ latency < 6ms, NAT egress throughput >= 1.5Gbps per AZ
- Cost gate: estimated steady-state cost within 10% of forecast or needs approval for burst usage

prashant: I can run the perf harness for the SLOs. Which model profile should we target? 7B quantized and a 13B fp16.

alex: Start with 7B quantized (batch sizes 1/4/16), sequence length 128 and 512. Then run 13B fp16 for 128. Collect p50/p95/p99 + GPU util.

maria: Networking check: I validated BGP routes and the transit gateway. However the secondary NAT gateway in AZ-B shows fluctuating SNAT connections — likely ephemeral port exhaustion during stress.

eve: Is that during the kube e2e test or the perf run? We need separate repro.

maria: Observed during kubelet image pulls when we spun up the 3x daemonsets. Logs show `conntrack: table full`.

shawn: Increasing conntrack on NAT gateway helps but we should also add retry/backoff to the image puller. For immediate, I bumped conntrack limit from 65536 to 262144 on nat-b.

alex: Good quick fix. Make sure to add a postmortem note in the runbook and add a persistent config in infra repo.

lina: Redeploy finished, node-07 is back in schedule pool. `kubectl get nodes -o wide` snippet: 
```
NAME       STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION    GPU
node-07    Ready    worker   12m   v1.26.4    1 x A100
...\n```

prashant: Starting perf run now (harness v2). Running 7B q8_0 profile batch=1/4/16 seq=128/512. Will post results.

deploy-bot: perf-run-493 queued, expected duration ~ 18m.

(10m later)

prashant: 7B q8 results: batch=1 p95=88ms p99=210ms util=62%
batch=4 p95=105ms p99=260ms util=79%
batch=16 p95=150ms p99=420ms util=93%

alex: Good. p95 within gate for batch 1/4, batch 16 pushes p99 and util—should be behind autoscale/burst policy, not steady. Add note to default config to cap batch to 8 for latency-sensitive routes.

maria: Cost check: based on current utilization we estimate hourly cost ~ $135/hr for SJC6 baseline (paid reserved + 15% burst). Forecast for steady 24/7 load is $3,240/day — within +8% of originally modeled.

eve: We should flag if burst > 20% sustained for >1h — that requires finance approval. For now looks OK.

shawn: I also ran the KV cache integrity test against the new prefix cache nodes — TTL and read-path latencies OK (p95 6ms).

alex: Outstanding items left: 
1) Add conntrack limit change to terraform module for nat-b (owner: shawn)
2) Update default batch cap to 8 for low-latency routes (owner: alex)
3) Add driver bake check to image pipeline to avoid node-07 mismatch (owner: lina)
4) Create cost alert for sustained burst >20% for >1h (owner: eve)

lina: I'll open PRs for driver bake & image tests now.

shawn: PR for conntrack terraform inbound — will link.

prashant: Perf run for 13B fp16 queued as follow-up. If that passes, I'm happy to sign off on performance gate.

alex: Cool — once 13B run is green and PRs are merged, we can go to readiness review. Schedule 30m handoff with SRE + Solutions next hour?

maria: I can do the readiness review doc. Will include SLO snapshots, cost delta, known mitigations.

eve: I'll set the approval flow for finance sign-off in case burst trends upward after release.

deploy-bot: perf-run-494 (13B fp16) started.

(8m later)

prashant: 13B fp16 results: batch=1 p95=118ms p99=290ms util=71% — within SLO but close at p99, recommend canary rollout with automatic fallback to smaller model on p99 breach.

alex: Perfect. Rolling checklist: all gates green except follow-up PRs and terraform change. If owners can finish within the hour, we do handoff. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
